mountain.name: Mountain
mountain.desc: rocky formation in any land; some very high; added 2012-03

plateau.name: Plateau / Cliff
plateau.desc: flat top with cliff border (block type 5/6)

valley.name: Valley
valley.desc: basin surrounded by mountains, smooth floor, lower rims; boss at centre (insectoids, mosquitoes, flies)

canyon.name: Canyon
canyon.desc: depression with large mesas inside and larger mesas on rim

cave.name: Cave
cave.desc: deposits, shimmer mushrooms, bats, rocklings; underwater caves in oceans; boulders needing bombs; block type Cave=18 (S); added 2012-01

river.name: River
river.desc: with small waterfalls (2011-12); tunnels through giant rocks; lava rivers; toxic rivers (S); new rivers 2017

lake.name: Lake
lake.desc: 'Lake ___'; river-connected; may hide a divine harp

lava-lake.name: Lava Lake
lava-lake.desc: above-ground magma pool; dry lands + lava lands; may hold a building/island reachable by glider

island.name: Island
island.desc: generic small + named large '___ Island'; temples on large ones

sky-island.name: Floating / Sky Island
sky-island.desc: small island in the sky with 1 treasure; reached by sky whistle at bird statue or glider+climb

forest.name: Forest (generic)
forest.desc: birch (lime leaves) / pine / normal; aesthetic; map colour clusters

dungeon-forest.name: Dungeon Forest
dungeon-forest.desc: named ('Duragar Forest'); connected canopies block light; campsites; typed roster + boss (see creature-families)

field.name: Field / Farm
field.desc: around villages (2012-05); green dots on map; pumpkins, pineapples, kale; Ω fenced wheat + windmills

road.name: Road
road.desc: leads to villages/POIs; auto tunnels through mountains and bridges over canyons (2011-07); street lights

cloud.name: Cloud
cloud.desc: voxel structures high up, no collision, static (A/S); Ω moving

giant-rock.name: Giant Rock
giant-rock.desc: massive hard-to-climb rock, small top, boss at centre; smaller on river

giant-tree.name: Giant Tree
giant-tree.desc: tallest structure, boss at top; replaced by Mana Tree in S

overhang.name: Overhang
overhang.desc: exists (cliffs, caves); column storage = base-z + run, exact multi-gap representation unknown (?)

kingdom-frontier-wall.name: Kingdom frontier wall with guards
kingdom-frontier-wall.desc: 2012 devlog; shipped only as visible 'frontier between two lands' (?)
